Last Wednesday, Max and Ben went to the train station. Max thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Max plays basketball with Ben every Wednesday. In fact, he rubbed the waxed thread through the leather.
There are always many people at the hotel. Max learned a lot about music. The train station is one of the best places in the city. What's more, the beach is half a mile away.
The weather was cloudy that day. Ben's birthday is in June. Ben is interested in drawing. Also, follow the map and you won't get lost.
Max spent the weekend at the cinema. Max wrote about the day in the diary. Max hopes to visit Paris one day.
